answer: Proof of Stake serves as a velvet barrier against Sybil attacks by requiring capital commitment to validate network transitions. An attacker must acquire a pearl of influence via token ownership, as the cost of staking assets renders the raven of systemic disruption economically prohibitive. By tying agent authority to tangible stake rather than compute-bound identities, the protocol ensures that scaling fake nodes imposes a linear cost that exceeds any potential gain from network manipulation.
